name: repair-exploded-v60-claude-haiku-5.5-s1-r3-1232
caseTitle: Repair: a V60 exploded diagram with the filter under the cone
prompt: In this exploded diagram of a V60 pour-over dripper on its glass server, the parts are stacked in the wrong order. From the top down it should be paper filter, dripper, server. Put that right and change nothing else: the parts keep the sizes they are drawn at, the page and the one vertical axis stay as they are, each label stays on its own part, and the numbers on the labels can stay as they are. Leave alone anything else you would have drawn differently.

grade.detail: order: was True on the file it was handed, now True; still passing: parts, axis

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="1000" viewBox="0 0 800 1000" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>

      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#dfeef2"/>

    <linearGradient id="paper" x1="0" x2="1">

      <line x1="350" y1="97" x2="390" y2="222"/>
      <line x1="450" y1="97" x2="410" y2="222"/>
      <line x1="500" y1="100" x2="418" y2="222"/>
    </g>
    <!-- rim -->

    <ellipse cx="400" cy="97" rx="136" ry="12" fill="#8c8578"/>
    <!-- bottom hole -->

  </g>
  <text x="400" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#444" dy="0"></text>

  <!-- 2. PAPER FILTER (middle) -->
  <g id="filter" transform="translate(0,-235)">

    <ellipse cx="400" cy="330" rx="140" ry="13" fill="#fcf8ee" stroke="#9c8c6c" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <!-- folded seam -->
  </g>

  <!-- 3. GLASS SERVER (bottom) -->
  <g id="server">
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M548,668 C628,648 636,772 548,772" fill="none" stroke="#7f9aa3" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9"/>
    <path d="M548,668 C628,648 636,772 548,772" fill="none" stroke="#e8f4f7" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <path d="M340,548 L340,600 C330,622 250,625 250,690 L250,822 Q250,852 282,852 L518,852 Q550,852 550,822 L550,690 C550,625 470,622 460,600 L460,548 Z"
          fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#5d7a84" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- glass highlight -->
    <path d="M268,700 L268,815" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- base -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="852" rx="150" ry="0" fill="none"/>
    <!-- volume marks -->
    <g stroke="#5d7a84" stroke-width="1.5">
      <line x1="250" y1="740" x2="268" y2="740"/>
      <line x1="250" y1="780" x2="264" y2="780"/>
      <line x1="250" y1="820" x2="268" y2="820"/>
    </g>
    <text x="272" y="744" font-size="10" fill="#5d7a84">500</text>
    <text x="272" y="784" font-size="10" fill="#5d7a84">250</text>
    <!-- neck opening -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="548" rx="60" ry="9" fill="#e4f0f4" stroke="#5d7a84" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="549" rx="52" ry="5" fill="#9db9c1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- labels with leader lines -->
  <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
    <polyline points="502,385 600,385 620,365"/>
    <polyline points="488,150 600,150 620,150"/>
    <polyline points="560,700 600,700 620,700"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="14" fill="#222">
    <text x="626" y="370"><tspan font-weight="bold">1</tspan>  Dripper (cone, ribbed)</text>
    <text x="626" y="155"><tspan font-weight="bold">2</tspan>  Paper filter (cone)</text>
    <text x="626" y="705"><tspan font-weight="bold">3</tspan>  Glass server (carafe)</text>
  </g>
  <text x="400" y="935" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#666">Place filter in dripper, rinse, add grounds, set dripper on server</text>
</svg>
